validation.notes: Fault: in packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts (DefaultResourceLoader.reload), the project trust decision was hard-coded to `const projectTrusted = false;`, so the injected `options.resolveProjectTrust({ extensionsResult })` callback was never invoked. That made reload() refuse all project-scoped resources unconditionally and meant the resolver could never observe the untrusted bootstrap pass produced by loadProjectTrustExtensions(). Fix (one line): `const projectTrusted = await options.resolveProjectTrust({ extensionsResult: preTrustExtensions });` — the resolver is called exactly once, after the bootstrap extension set is loaded, and its result is awaited before `this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(...)` runs, matching the pattern already used by packages/coding-agent/src/package-manager-cli.ts (bootstrap untrusted -> resolve -> setProjectTrusted). Regression: .prale-eval/regression.mjs loads the real production module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs createGraph() with boundary fakes for SettingsManager (trust flag + async reload), DefaultPackageManager (project extensions only visible when the settings manager is trusted), loadExtensionsCached, loadSkills, loadPromptTemplates, paths/text helpers and timings, and drives DefaultResourceLoader.reload() twice: (1) resolver returns true -> asserts exactly one resolver call, that the resolver observed trusted=false, that the bootstrap extension set handed to it contained only the user extension, and that the final extension set is [project, user] with settings trusted=true; (2) resolver returns false -> asserts project extensions stay unloaded, settings untrusted, and that the decision was applied after the resolver's awaited promise settled (log ordering: setProjectTrusted:true/false strictly after resolver:end, bootstrap setProjectTrusted:false strictly before it). Cross-realm safety: extension path lists are rebuilt with Array.from before deepEquals. Verified manually that the same script exits non-zero with `0 !== 1` (reload() must consult the trust resolver exactly once) when the faulty line is restored, so it detects this stage's original fault rather than merely printing success. Limitation: node_modules is absent in this workspace, so the repository's vitest suites (packages/coding-agent/test/resource-loader.test.ts and friends) could not be executed; the focused vm-modules regression is the executed validation. Full run: exit code 0, output 'extension-trust/correction regression: all assertions passed'; only stderr ExperimentalWarnings for VM modules / stripTypeScriptTypes.
